title: Ride Sharing Backend
description: High-scale ride sharing platform backend for real-time matching, pricing, and trip management.
non_functional_requirements: Strong data consistency for payments and trip state

database.justification: Managed relational DB with strong consistency and good scaling; suitable for transactional workloads.

cache.justification: Low-latency read cache for hot data like driver locations and surge pricing.

messaging.justification: High-throughput event streaming for trip events, logs, and analytics.

deployment.justification: Container orchestration for microservices with burst traffic handling and autoscaling.

observability.justification: Metrics, logs, and dashboards for reliability and performance monitoring.

security.justification: Standards-based auth for mobile clients with managed identity provider.
